title: Republic of China Minguo Calendar
intro: The Republic of China (Minguo) calendar applies a national era-year label to Gregorian civil dates.
epoch: Gregorian 1912 is Minguo year 1, following the founding of the Republic of China.
structure: Gregorian month names, lengths, leap days and weekday order remain unchanged.
model: For Gregorian dates from 1912 onward, Minguo year = Gregorian year - 1911. The date coordinate and navigation remain Gregorian-derived.
example: 15 June 2026 is 15 June Minguo 115; the weekday is the same in both notations.
history: Minguo era numbering is particularly familiar in official and other records in Taiwan, where Gregorian labels may also be encountered.
limits: Not a lunar calendar. Retrospective era labels must not be taken as evidence of official use before the Republic.
